paragraphs.text: Vintara (also Wintara ) is an almost impregnable forest on the northeastern subcontinent of Jamuraa on Dominaria .
The Vintaran Forest lies on the southwestern coast of the subcontinent. It borders the Jamuraan Sea . Vintara is 700 miles wide and has a 400 mile-long front with the swamp of Nakaya .
Vintara is a source of trainable elephants . It is also home to vicious turtles .
Vintara once saw the Lich Lord Deadalus attempt to take power over the green dragon Chloridon , but ended up being killed by the black dragon Destruction instead.
